async function mineEightCocoaPods(bot) {
    // This function attempts to gather eight cocoa pods. It first checks if the required number of cocoa beans is already in the inventory, and if so, it stops. If all search efforts fail to yield the required amount, it throws an error indicating the search was exhausted.
